start.why: We ask these questions so answers can be compared across groups. Nothing here identifies you.
start.under18Text: Unfortunately, this study is open to adults (18+) only.
start.backgroundHint: This is a sensitive question. You don’t have to answer.

consent.default:
This is an anonymous academic study of how people understand the concept of “Maʼnaviyat” (spirituality).
We never ask for or store your name, email, phone number or IP address.
Your answers are used for research only and published only in aggregate.
Taking part is voluntary: you can stop at any time and delete your answers with the “Delete my data” link or with the delete code shown at the end.
It takes about {minutes} minutes. Participants must be 18 or older.

survey.title: Questionnaire
survey.q1: What is the first word or image that comes to your mind when you hear the word “Maʼnaviyat” (spirituality)?
survey.q1Hint: Don’t overthink it. Write the first thing that comes to mind.
survey.q2: Which concepts do you most closely associate with spirituality?
survey.q3: In everyday life, how often do you hear or use the word “Maʼnaviyat” (spirituality)?
survey.q4: Is spirituality more about a person’s inner emotional state, or about their social and moral behavior towards others?
survey.otherRequired: Type your “Other” answer or untick it.

game.introRule2: Don’t overthink it: there are no right or wrong answers.
game.introRule3: One word or a short phrase per field. Press Enter to move on.

about.title: About the research
about.p1: “Maʼnaviyat Xaritasi” (Map of Spirituality) is a non-profit academic project studying how people understand “maʼnaviyat” (spirituality) and the values close to it.
about.p2: The method is word association: participants see a word and type the first words that come to mind. Thousands of answers are combined into a map of how concepts connect.
about.p3: Results are published only in aggregate, in academic papers and reports.
about.privacy1: We don’t store names, emails, phone numbers or IP addresses.
about.privacy2: Your browser keeps only a random session key (a cookie), so you don’t lose progress and can delete your answers.
about.privacy3: The question about religious background is optional, and it is never shown for groups smaller than 5 people.
about.deleteText: All answers sent from this device will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
about.deleteNone: There are no saved answers on this device.
about.retentionDefault: Anonymous answers are kept for as long as the research project needs them and are then archived or deleted under the institution’s data policy. You can delete yours at any time.
about.deleteCodeText: Using another device or cleared your cookies? Enter the delete code from your results page.
about.deleteCodeInvalid: That doesn’t look like a delete code. It has 12 letters and numbers, like ABCD-EFGH-JK23.
about.deleteCodeUnknown: No answers were found for this code. They may already be deleted.
